items.title: Caiaphas and the council
items.charge: Seeking false witness against Christ; condemning him by night; delivering him to the Gentiles; forbidding the apostles; stoning Stephen

items.title: Daniel's accusers
items.charge: Conspiring by law against an innocent man

items.title: Jezebel and Naboth's vineyard
items.charge: Judicial murder to seize an inheritance

items.title: Job's three friends
items.charge: Speaking of God the thing that is not right; condemning the righteous

items.title: Potiphar's wife
items.charge: Soliciting her husband's servant day by day, and bearing false witness against him when he fled

items.title: Simon the governor of the temple
items.charge: Betraying the temple treasury to the king out of a private quarrel; slandering Onias the high priest

items.title: Susanna
items.charge: Choosing to fall into the hands of the elders rather than sin in the sight of the Lord

items.title: The chief priests, and the watch at the sepulchre
items.charge: Paying the soldiers large money to report a lie about the resurrection

items.title: The false witnesses against Stephen
items.charge: Suborning witnesses and stirring up the council against a man they could not answer

items.title: The ten spies
items.charge: Bringing an evil report; making the congregation to murmur

items.title: The two elders who accused Susanna
items.charge: Attempted adultery by extortion; false witness against an innocent woman
